name: Dynamic Llumeneres 2-Person Full Spectrum Near-Zero EMF Far Infrared Sauna
description: Dynamic Llumeneres 2-Person Full Spectrum Near-Zero EMF (Under 3 mg) Far Infrared Sauna Want to bring the luxury of a spa into the comfort of your own home? Dynamic Saunas are built from eco-friendly Canadian Hemlock wood, combining natural strength with a sleek, modern finish that enhances any space. With advanced Low EMF FAR infrared heating panels, each sauna delivers safe, energy-efficient heat that encourages relaxation, supports circulation, and helps restore balance to your body. Flexible and easy to set up, Dynamic Saunas are designed to fit seamlessly into a variety of indoor spaces whether it’s a master bath, basement, walk-in closet, or personal gym. Their compact yet durable design makes them an ideal choice for homeowners who want both wellness and convenience in one. Choosing a Dynamic Sauna means investing in daily comfort, long-term health benefits, and a private retreat you can enjoy anytime. Features: Near-zero EMF - EMF under 3 mg 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Full 2-person capacity Natural Canadian Reforested Hemlock wood construction Tempered glass door Interior chromotherapy lighting system with red light feature 6 Total Heaters, 4 PureTech™ Near Zero EMF (EMF Under 3MG when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating elements) FAR IR Carbon Heating Panels, 2 Near IR Elements Interior LED Control Panel Bluetooth, MP3 auxiliary connection with built in speakers Clasp together assembly Ships in 2 boxes Specifications: Sauna weight: 350 lbs. Shipping weight: 395 lbs. Electrical service: 120V/15amp plug & play Exterior dimensions (LWH): 42" x 48" x 75" Interior dimensions (LWH): 38" x 44" x 68" Document: View Owner's Manual
